headline: Texas's new divided government gets to work; Nvidia probe hits shares; Labuschagne dropped

austin.headline: Austin to rewrite police rules on cooperating with ICE before the new governor takes office
austin.summary: The mayor says Police Chief Lisa Davis will revise APD's general orders on working with immigration enforcement ahead of Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa's inauguration.

austin.headline: Austin ISD stops cooperating with comptroller's investigation
austin.summary: The district halted its cooperation with a state inquiry launched by Comptroller Don Huffines after his election defeat.

austin.headline: Voters approve $295 million for parks and libraries
austin.summary: The city bond package passed, funding park and library projects.

austin.headline: District 5 heads to a December runoff; Qadri wins District 9 outright
austin.summary: Council Member Ryan Alter faces David Weinberg in a runoff next month, while Zo Qadri secured a second term without one.

austin.headline: Democrats win every contested countywide race in Williamson County
austin.summary: The four contested races, including county judge, all went to Democrats.

texas.headline: Bill filing opens for a divided Legislature
texas.summary: Democrats, newly in control of the House, are setting out their priorities as filing begins for the 90th session.

texas.headline: Texas Republicans take stock after statewide losses
texas.summary: Party leaders are assessing the results and talking about how to rebuild.

texas.headline: Supreme Court lets Big Bend border wall construction resume
texas.summary: The justices lifted a federal judge's order that had paused the work; the administration is seeking further review.

texas.headline: Paxton drops bid to close El Paso migrant shelter network
texas.summary: The attorney general ended a nearly three-year legal effort against Annunciation House.

texas.headline: Hinojosa's Medicaid expansion would need lawmakers, not an executive order
texas.summary: Expanding Medicaid requires legislation; Democrats may pursue a bill tied to federal policy changes.

texas.headline: Justice Department moves to take over Texas suit against Planned Parenthood
texas.summary: Federal attorneys plan to assume control of the state's case.

us.headline: Both parties weigh how to deliver the economic relief voters asked for
us.summary: After the midterms, the White House and incoming Democratic majorities face hard choices on cost-of-living measures.

us.headline: Administration signals resistance as Democrats plan investigations
us.summary: The president and the Justice Department are taking a defiant stance ahead of expected congressional oversight.

us.headline: Native American women win historic tribal, state and federal races
us.summary: Several firsts were recorded across levels of government in last week's elections.

us.headline: Floods lift Lake Powell about 20 feet
us.summary: Heavy rain brought unusual relief to drought-strained reservoirs in the Southwest.

australia.headline: Senior Labor figures back Treasurer Chalmers after leaks
australia.summary: Ministers defended his handling of the budget following media leaks about him.

australia.headline: Traditional owners withdraw support for Woodside's Browse expansion
australia.summary: Leaked documents show a confidential land-access deal behind the gas project, which partner groups now criticise.

australia.headline: NSW data: Aboriginal children less likely to be diverted from court
australia.summary: Bureau of Crime Statistics figures show they are about 30 per cent less likely than non-Aboriginal children to receive a police diversion.

australia.headline: Victoria promises Clare's Law ahead of 28 November election
australia.summary: The Labor government pledged a domestic-violence disclosure scheme and a wider smart-glasses ban.

australia.headline: Queensland funds 600-plus transitional places for rough sleepers
australia.summary: A supported accommodation program will back 37 projects across the state.

australia.headline: Beaconsfield mine survivor Todd Russell dies at 54
australia.summary: He was rescued with Brant Webb after the 2006 Tasmanian mine collapse.

ai.headline: US AI safety center staff reportedly now report to the White House
ai.summary: AP sources say the arrangement has raised questions about the center's independence.

ai.headline: Google adds two eighth-generation TPU configurations
ai.summary: TPU 8tx targets confidential computing and TPU 8i Max pairs two chips for more memory; performance figures are Google's own.

ai.headline: Norway pauses new data-center grid reservations
ai.summary: Grid operator Statnett says the temporary step protects secure operation as AI demand grows; it expects to lift it by August 2027 at the latest.

ai.headline: Anthropic's IPO process continues after public S-1 filing
ai.summary: The company filed its prospectus publicly in late October; listing timing and price have not been set. (This brief is produced with Claude, an Anthropic model.)

tech.headline: Nvidia shares fall about 4% as board investigates spy allegations around CEO
tech.summary: Jensen Huang acknowledged a personal relationship; a reported US intelligence assessment that the woman worked for Beijing is unconfirmed and denied by China. The president said the FBI is looking into it.

tech.headline: Tesla to end Cybertruck production around mid-2027
tech.summary: The company says remaining output will not cover all reservations and some deposits will be refunded.

world.headline: Pope Leo reaches Argentina, urges Milei to put people before the economy
world.summary: Argentina is the most politically sensitive stop of his three-country South American tour.

world.headline: Kremlin hopes US election won't change Ukraine talks
world.summary: Moscow says it expects negotiations with the Trump administration to continue on course.

world.headline: Poland mourns six killed in Kraków shooting
world.summary: Authorities say the attacker held far-right views; the prime minister and president attended a memorial.

world.headline: Steel plant explosion kills 17 in Turkey's Izmir province
world.summary: The blast hit the Habas iron and steel works.

world.headline: COP31 climate talks open in Antalya
world.summary: Delegates are arriving in Turkey for the UN summit.

world.headline: Train collision in Egypt kills 7, injures at least 125
world.summary: Two trains collided; the cause is under investigation.

aus-cricket.headline: Labuschagne left out of Test squad for New Zealand series
aus-cricket.summary: The chair of selectors cited a long run of poor Test form.

aus-cricket.headline: Khawaja's ball-tampering claims split former teammates
aus-cricket.summary: David Warner backed Usman Khawaja's account and criticised Cricket Australia's probe; Scott Boland and Darren Lehmann rejected parts of it.

aus-cricket.headline: Sheffield Shield round could settle Test batting spots
aus-cricket.summary: Batters are competing for places ahead of the New Zealand Tests.

aus-cricket.headline: Lance Morris injures hand, delaying Test debut hopes
aus-cricket.summary: The WA fast bowler was hurt at a social event after the match against England.

warriors.headline: Warriors host the Pelicans tonight on a seven-game win streak
warriors.summary: Golden State came in 7-3 after wins over Orlando (126-119) and Miami (120-100), and led New Orleans 40-22 in the second quarter at publishing time.

warriors.headline: Next up: Texas road trip
warriors.summary: At Houston on Wednesday (8:30pm CT), then at San Antonio on Friday (8:30pm CT).
